dct_description_sm: There was little information in the scientific literature on bowhead whale diet for the Eastern Canada-West Greenland population. We wanted to provide information on bowhead whale diet from stomach content analysis of four subsistence harvested specimens from the Canadian Arctic. Our data are the first data on stomach content analysis from the EC-WG population.   Our data provided the first evidence of prey consumption by three bowhead whales, two juveniles (one male and one female) and one large pregnant adult female, from the EC-WG population representing the first stomach content data for this population.
dct_title_s: Stomach Contents Data of Bowhead whales (Balaena mysticetus) in the Canadian Arctic
